- Do not infer or alter values beyond formatting (convert comma decimal to dot for numeric fields).
- Provide extracted values in required schema types: numeric for amounts and VAT rate, string for Invoice.Date and Sender.VatId.
- If multiple VAT groups existed, would return as array entries; here single VAT group.
